title: Bicycle
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 2 "circle left 2 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 4 "circle left 2 places every one is home!" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 5 "balance the ring" can't start from where the dancers are: A ring balance of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "star right - hands across - 3 places and pass thru to new neighbors · pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
Row 7 "star right - hands across - 3 places and pass thru to new neighbors · pass through" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 2 must face exactly one dancer to pass.
The progression after row 7 "star right - hands across - 3 places and pass thru to new neighbors · pass through" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must stand side by side to find new neighbors.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
